correctness.rationale: For each translation, the STFT row is the Fourier transform of at most two point masses. If one point is occupied the row has all \(N\) frequencies; if two are occupied it loses exactly \(d=\gcd(a,N)\) frequencies precisely when the coefficient ratio is an \(L=N/d\)-th root. Thus minimizing total support is maximizing simultaneously good directed internal edges of the step-\(a\) cycles. All edges of a proper occupied path, and of a complete even cycle, can be made good by alternating phases; a complete odd cycle must lose exactly one because the product of the required ratios would be \(-1\). Hence the optimum number of good edges is \(E_a(S)-Q_a(S)\), proving the exact formula. Componentwise minimization gives global \(N\) only at \(L=2\), and otherwise \(2N\) exactly for singleton support. The package's exhaustive small-\(N\) replay is consistent with the analytic proof.
